    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AddPlayerRequest
    Sent by a client to join an already-created game.
    AddPointsEndGame
    Building card that grants a flat extra amount of victory points at the end of the game, on top of the building's own base points.
    ArtistCharCard
    Artist character card.
    ArtistEventFoodBonus
    Building card that grants the owner one food per artist they own whenever the Pitture Rupestri event is resolved.
    ArtistsEvCard
    Pitture Rupestri (artists) event: players with fewer than minArtists artists lose losePoints victory points; the rest gain winPointsPerArtist per artist they own.
    BaseTUIController
    Base class for every TUI screen.
    Board
    Shared central board holding the structures every player interacts with during a round: the pool of OrderTiles used by players to pick their turn order, the seven OfferTiles where totems are placed, two rows (upper / lower) of BuildingCards, two rows (upper / lower) of character / event Cards. The class implements Serializable so the full board can be snapshotted by the persistence layer.
    BoardDTO
    Transport snapshot of the shared central board.
    BoardFactory
    Setup-time helper that builds a fresh Board populated with the offer and order tiles appropriate for the current game size.
    BoardUpdatedMessage
    Sent when the shared board changes (e.g. after a card is picked) to push the refreshed board state to the clients.
    BuilderCharCard
    Builder character card.
    BuildingCard
    Base class for all building cards.
    BuildingCardFactory
    CardFactory implementation that loads BuildingCards from /json/buildingCards.json.
    BuildingDeck
    Deck specialisation holding only BuildingCards.
    BuildingDeckFactory
    DeckFactory implementation that assembles the shuffled BuildingDeck for a given era.
    Card
    Common base class for every card in the game.
    CardCatalog
    Card/tile lookup for the TUI.
    CardCatalog.ClassKind
    Visual/logical kind of a card: the six character types, plus BUILDING, EVENT and UNKNOWN (used as a neutral fallback for ids the catalog does not know).
    CardFactory<T>
    Factory abstraction for loading a family of Cards for a given game configuration.
    CardInfoCatalog
    Builds rich, human-readable Italian descriptions for every card and tile, used as hover tooltips in the game view.
    CardPicking
    Card-picking phase of each round: players, iterated in offer-tile order, resolve their claimed OfferTile by drawing the allowed number of cards from the upper and lower rows.
    CardPickRequest
    Sent by a client to pick a card from the board.
    CardType
    Discriminator for the three families of cards in the game.
    CharacterCard
    Base class for the six character cards.
    CharacterCardFactory
    CardFactory implementation that loads CharacterCards from /json/characterCards.json.
    CharacterDeckFactory
    DeckFactory implementation that assembles the shuffled character Deck for a given era.
    CharacterType
    The six character archetypes a player can collect during the game.
    ClientConnection
    Server-side view of a single connected client, regardless of the underlying transport (RMI or socket).
    ClientMain
    Entry point of the GUI client.
    ClientMainTUI
    Entry point of the textual (TUI) client.
    ClientRequest
    A command sent from a client to the server.
    CollectorCharCard
    Collector character card.
    ConnectionFactory
    Factory that lets the client open a connection to the server without knowing the transport details.
    ConnectionManager
    Client-side wrapper around the active server connection that adds transparent automatic reconnection.
    CreateGameRequest
     
    CurrentPlayerDTO
    Identifies the player whose turn it currently is, so the clients can highlight the active player.
    CurrentPlayerUpdateMessage
    Sent when the turn passes to a different player, so the clients can update which player is shown as active.
    DatabaseManager
    JDBC-backed LeaderboardDAO that stores match results in a PostgreSQL (Supabase) database.
    Deck
    Shuffled, draw-from-top deck of cards.
    DeckFactory
    Factory abstraction for assembling a Deck for a given game configuration.
    DoubleBuildersPoints
    Building card that, at the end of the game, awards the owner a second copy of their builder points (effectively doubling the contribution of builder character cards).
    EndGameController
    Controller for the end-game screen.
    EndGameDTO
    A single standings row produced at the end of a game.
    EndGameService
    Server-side GameObserver that handles end-of-game processing.
    EndRoundSnapshotDTO
    Snapshot sent to the clients when a round ends, after the board has advanced (rows shifted and refilled).
    EndRoundUpdateMessage
    Sent when a round ends, carrying the end-of-round snapshot (board after the rows have advanced, players' stats and the player who opens the new round).
    ErrorMessage
    Sent by the server to a single client to report a rejected action (e.g. a duplicate nickname or an illegal move).
    EventCard
    Base class for the four event cards.
    EventCardFactory
    CardFactory implementation that loads EventCards from /json/eventCards.json.
    EventOutcomeDTO
    Per-player result of a single resolved Event card: how much Food and how many Prestige Points the player gained (positive) or lost (negative) from that one event.
    EventResolvedMessage
    Notifies clients that an Event card has been resolved, carrying its id and the per-player Food/Points outcome (EventOutcomeDTO) so the events log can show what each player gained or lost.
    EvType
    Discriminator for the four kinds of event cards in the game.
    ExtraUpperCardAfterActions
    Building card that grants one extra upper-row card pick after every player has completed the normal card-picking phase.
    ExtraUpperCardPicking
    Optional post-picking phase where players with the matching building may take extra cards from the upper row before the round ends.
    FeedingSaleCharType
    Building card that, during a sustenance event, grants the owner one extra food per character of a specific CharacterType.
    FoodBonusOrderTile
    Building card that grants foodBonus extra food at the end of the owner's turn, provided the order tile assigned to that player for the current round has a positive food effect.
    FoodPerInventorPair
    Building card that grants foodBonus food each time the owner forms a new pair of inventors (i.e. when they own an inventor that has not yet contributed a unique invention).
    FoodPerSet
    Building card that grants bonusFood food each time the owner completes a new set of characters.
    GameAbortedMessage
    Sent to the remaining clients when the game is aborted because a player disconnected and did not reconnect in time.
    GameController
    Server-side entry point that turns client actions into operations on the GameModel.
    GameController
    In-game TUI screen.
    GameEndedMessage
    Sent when the game ends, carrying both the final standings of the just-played match and the persisted global leaderboard for games of the same size, so clients can show the results and the all-time ranking together.
    GameEnding
    Terminal state.
    GameEvent
    Discriminator for the events the model broadcasts through its observer channel.
    GameModel
    Aggregate root of the game's model layer.
    GameObserver
    Observer of the game model.
    GameResultSaver
     
    GameSnapshotDTO
    Full snapshot of the game, carrying everything a client needs to (re)build its view from scratch.
    GameSnapshotMessage
    Sent when the game starts (and on resync) to deliver a full game snapshot, giving the clients everything needed to build their in-game view from scratch.
    GameState
    Base class for the State pattern that drives the game lifecycle.
    GameStateDTO
    Carries the current game phase to the clients as a State enum value, so the views can compare it for equality instead of matching on the (unstable) state-class name.
    GameStateUpdateMessage
    Sent when the game advances to a new phase, so the clients can react to the current State (e.g. enabling/disabling actions).
    GameSyncRequest
    Sent by a client to ask the server to push the current game state.
    GUIApp
    JavaFX Application entry point for the GUI client.
    HunterCharCard
    Hunter character card.
    HuntingEvCard
    Hunting event: each player gains one food per hunter they own and winPointsPerHunter victory points per hunter.
    HuntingEventFoodPointsBonus
    Building card that, during a hunting event, grants the owner an extra unit of food and an extra victory point per hunter they own (on top of the hunting event's own rewards).
    InvalidActionException
    Checked exception thrown when a player attempts an action that is not allowed in the current game state — e.g. acting out of turn, picking an unavailable card, or making a move that violates the rules.
    InventorCharCard
    Inventor character card.
    LeaderboardDAO
    Persistence abstraction for the cross-game leaderboard.
    LobbyController
    Controller for the lobby screen, shown while players gather before a game starts.
    LobbyController
    TUI lobby screen: shows the players who have joined and the target game size while waiting for the lobby to fill.
    LobbyStateMessage
    Sent when a player joins the lobby, carrying the players currently in it and the target game size so clients can show how many slots are still open.
    LobbyStateRequest
    Sent by a client to ask the server for the current lobby state.
    MessageVisitor
    Visitor for handling ServerMessages on the client side, with one visit overload per concrete message type.
    NetworkConnectionFactory
    Concrete ConnectionFactory that establishes the client's connection to the server over either RMI or sockets, returning in both cases a ServerAdapter the client can talk through.
    NetworkSetupController
    First TUI screen: it asks the user for the connection settings (RMI or socket, server IP and port), opens the connection through the factory and wraps it in a ConnectionManager for automatic reconnection, then registers it on the context.
    OfferTile
    One of the totem-placement slots on the board, identified by a letter (A–G).
    OfferTilesFactory
    Loads the offer-tile configuration from the bundled /json/offer_tiles.json resource and filters it for the current player count.
    OrderTile
    Turn-order tile picked by each player at the start of a round.
    OrderTilesFactory
    Loads the turn-order-tile configuration from the bundled /json/order_tiles.json resource and filters it for the current player count.
    PersistenceManager
    Static helper that persists the live GameModel to disk so the server can recover its state after a crash or restart.
    PingMessage
    Application-level heartbeat pushed periodically by the server to a socket client.
    PingRequest
    Application-level heartbeat sent periodically by a socket client to the server.
    Player
    One participant in the game.
    PlayerDTO
    Lightweight representation of a player used in the lobby, where only their identity matters and no gameplay stats exist yet.
    PlayersFilling
    Initial state — the lobby.
    PlayerStats
    Mutable bag of per-player gameplay state owned by a Player.
    PlayerStatsDTO
    Transport snapshot of a single player's in-game state.
    PlayerStatsUpdateMessage
    Sent when a single player's in-game state changes (e.g. after picking a card, on turn change or on a totem reset) to push that player's refreshed stats to the clients.
    PlayerVirtualView
    Server-side GameObserver that translates model events into network messages sent to a client.
    PointsPerCharType
    Building card that, at the end of the game, awards the owner pointsPerCharacter victory points per character of a specific CharacterType they own.
    PointsPerSet
    Building card that, at the end of the game, awards the owner bonusPoints victory points per character set they have completed.
    PreLobbyController
    Controller for the pre-lobby screen, where the player either creates a new game, joins an existing one, or reconnects to a game already in progress.
    PreLobbyController
    TUI pre-lobby screen: it queries the server for the current state and then runs one of three flows depending on that state — create a new game, join an open lobby, or reconnect to a game that is already in progress (the persistence/resume case, e.g. after a server restart).
    PreLobbyStateMessage
    Sent in response to a pre-lobby state sync, telling a connecting client whether a game already exists and is in progress and which nicknames and colours are already taken, so the client can decide whether to create / join / reconnect and validate the player's choices.
    RankingEntry
    One row of the final ranking produced by GameModel.computeRanking(): the player, their 1-based rank (shared by players tied on points and food), and whether they are among the winners (shared victory is possible).
    ReconnectRequest
    Sent by a client to rejoin a game in progress after a disconnection.
    RmiClient
    Client-side RMI endpoint.
    RmiClientHandler
    Server-side ClientConnection for one RMI client, wrapping that client's remote VirtualViewRmi stub.
    RmiServer
    RMI side of the server: an exported VirtualServerRmi that clients look up in the registry to join the game, send requests and ping the server.
    RoundEnding
    Transient end-of-round state.
    ServerAdapter
    Client-side abstraction of the connection to the server, independent of the transport (RMI or socket).
    ServerApp
    Entry point of the Mesos server.
    ServerMessage
    An update pushed from the server to a client.
    ShamanCharCard
    Shaman character card.
    ShamanEventDouble
    Building card that, during a shaman event, awards the owner an additional copy of the event's win-points if they are tied at the highest shaman-stars total — effectively doubling the shaman event reward for the winner(s).
    ShamanNoLoss
    Building card that, during a shaman event, refunds the owner the event's lose-points if they are tied at the lowest shaman-stars total — effectively cancelling out the shaman event penalty for the loser(s).
    ShamansEvCard
    Shaman event: compares the shaman-star totals of all players.
    ShamanStarsBonus
    Building card that, upon being purchased, immediately grants the buyer bonusStars shaman stars in addition to charging the building's food cost.
    SkipExtraPickRequest
    Sent by a client to decline the optional extra upper-row pick granted by the relevant building card.
    SocketClient
    Client-side socket endpoint and ServerAdapter.
    SocketClientHandler
    Server-side ClientConnection for one socket client.
    SocketRmiChoiceController
    Controller for the first GUI screen, where the user chooses how to connect to the server (RMI or socket) and enters the host/port.
    SocketServer
    Socket side of the server.
    State
    Discriminator identifying which phase of the game the GameState state machine is currently in.
    SustenanceEvCard
    Sustenance event: each player must pay one food per character card they own, reduced by their feeding-sale discount (never below zero).
    TotemMoveRequest
    Sent by a client to place/move its totem onto an offer tile.
    TotemPlacement
    Turn-order phase of each round: every player, in the order dictated by their order tile, claims one free OfferTile by moving their totem onto it.
    TotemPositionDTO
    Position of one player's totem on the board, identified by the totem's colour.
    TotemsStateMessage
    Sent when the totem positions change (a totem is placed or all totems are reset) to push the current positions of every placed totem to the clients.
    TUIContext
    Central context of the textual client and holder of its shared, long-lived collaborators: the ConnectionFactory, the TUIDrawer used to render to the terminal, the TUIInputReader used to read user input and, once established, the ServerAdapter and the local player's nickname.
    TUIDrawer
    Terminal renderer for Mesos.
    TUIInputReader
    Reads user input from standard input for the TUI.
    UpdateHandler
    Client-side handler for everything the connection delivers from the server: game updates, errors and connection-lifecycle events.
    ViewGameController
    Controller for the main in-game screen.
    VirtualServerRmi
    Remote interface exposed by the RMI server to its clients.
    VirtualView
     
    VirtualViewRmi
    Remote callback interface exposed by an RMI client to the server.
